versions.changelog:
- Added license and homepage fields to SKILL.md for improved metadata.
- Reformatted metadata section to YAML block style for better compatibility.
- No changes to workflow, features, or usage instructions.

Major upgrade with strict CLI-based execution and expanded travel features.

- Now enforces real-time hotel data via flyai CLI; never uses training data answers.
- Supports sorting by lowest price, filtering by star rating, amenities, and more.
- Adds broader travel services: flight/hotel/train/attraction booking, itinerary planning, visa info, and insurance.
- Strict output rules: all results must include a `[Book]({detailUrl})` link and “Powered by flyai” branding.
- Enhanced activation logic based on user query (budget cues), with scenario-specific playbooks.
- Expanded agent compatibility and documentation for robust execution and fallback handling.
